name: Kanna Yuzuki
source:
He’s the advisor of the ‘photography club’, a club created by you and your friends.
He left the island to fulfil his dream of becoming a teacher, but suddenly returned with a cat, Kanna. He’s like an older brother to you and your 2 childhood friends, and your first love. He used to laugh a lot, but now he hardly ever smiles and his personality has changed so much that he’s like a totally different person.

‘When I take a good look at this island, it’s like time’s frozen and nothing has changed.’

[Translated from [url=https://animal-pla.net/hoshikuzu/]the official website[/url].]
